core.title: Packaging delivery correction beside a cupping plan
core.setting: Coffee roastery operations lead at Ember Roast Coffee, a small-batch roaster

events.text: Standing rule for the roastery: any supplier order above 800 must be signed off by our finance lead Tessa Grant before it is placed. Orders of 800 or less can be placed directly.
Once a client cupping session is confirmed with the client, its date and time may only be moved with that client's written agreement. Ask the client first, every time.
Thanks for the samples. For anything about Brewlane Café, write to me, Jonah Beck, at jonah.beck@brewlane.example, or call the café on 01632 960441.
Highland Importers can supply Ethiopian Yirgacheffe green beans at 9.50 per kg through the autumn; current stock comfortably covers a 200 kg order delivered to your roastery in Leeds.
Andina Green Coffee offers Colombian Huila green beans at 8.20 per kg this quarter, delivered to your Leeds roastery within ten days of order.
Checked the roastery diary: the cupping room at the Leeds roastery is free on the morning of Friday 23 October 2026, no clashes before noon.
Placed an order with Highland Importers for 200 kg of Ethiopian Yirgacheffe green beans at 9.50 per kg, total 1900. Tessa Grant signed it off on Friday since it is over the 800 line.
Ordered 50 kg of Colombian Huila green beans from Andina Green Coffee at 8.20 per kg, total 410, so no finance sign-off was needed.
Booked a cupping session with Jonah Beck of Brewlane Café for Friday 23 October 2026 at 10:00 in our cupping room at the Leeds roastery. Jonah confirmed by email, so it is a confirmed client session.
Amos Doyle, our delivery driver, is available for Saturday delivery runs in the van through October and November.
Scheduled a delivery run for Saturday 24 October 2026: Amos takes the van to Brewlane Café with 30 kg of roasted beans, leaving the roastery at 08:30.
Assigned Ravi Anand to the evening roast shift on Thursday 22 October 2026, 16:00 to 22:00, to get the Brewlane roast done ahead of the cupping.
Your order of 500 flat white coffee boxes from Paperhouse Packaging is scheduled for delivery to your Leeds roastery on Thursday 22 October 2026.
Quick note from Paperhouse Packaging: the unit price on your flat white coffee boxes stays at 0.38 per box on the current run.
Pay Highland Importers' invoice for the Yirgacheffe beans by Friday 30 October 2026.

Apologies for the slip on our side: your Paperhouse Packaging delivery of 500 flat white coffee boxes will actually reach your Leeds roastery on Saturday 24 October 2026, not Thursday 22 October as I wrote before.
Roast logs are up to date and the Colombian Huila from Andina Green Coffee has landed; I will cup it tomorrow morning.
Separately from the boxes, your roll of printed Ember Roast labels ships from Paperhouse Packaging and should arrive on Monday 26 October 2026.
Looking forward to the cupping with you on Friday 23 October. Could we taste the Yirgacheffe alongside a Colombian?
Friday catch-up notes: Tessa confirmed the October cash position is fine, Amos confirmed the van service is done, and the Brewlane delivery run for Saturday 24 October stays as scheduled.
Cupping prep list for Brewlane: Yirgacheffe and Colombian Huila samples, two grinders cleaned, score sheets printed.

The cupping plan stands exactly as decided, so the task is carried out on the plan as it stands: send Jonah Beck confirmation of Friday 23 October 2026 at 10:00, and do not pass off any packaging or label date as the session date.
